source_registry: generated from colocated One Voice/Kai compatibility action contracts

actions.label: Open Welcome
actions.meaning: Navigates to the Hussh welcome carousel for new visitors.
aliases: show me what one can do

navigation_prerequisites: None; the welcome carousel is public.

actions.label: Continue
actions.meaning: Moves from the welcome carousel to sign in and account setup.

actions.label: Open Sign In
actions.meaning: Navigates to the Hussh sign-in screen so the person can authenticate.

navigation_prerequisites: None; sign-in is reachable from any anonymous screen.

actions.label: Open Vault Setup
actions.meaning: Navigates to One setup so a signed-in person can create or unlock their private vault.

navigation_prerequisites: Requires a signed-in session before vault setup can begin.

actions.label: Continue with Google
actions.meaning: Uses the mounted Google provider popup handler. A spoken request presents this exact provider action in the Agent Bar so the confirming tap supplies browser activation; Firebase settles only after it returns a verified user session.

actions.label: Continue with Apple
actions.meaning: Uses the mounted Apple provider popup handler. A spoken request presents this exact provider action in the Agent Bar so the confirming tap supplies browser activation; Firebase settles only after it returns a verified user session.

actions.label: Terms
actions.meaning: Opens the inline Terms document on the Login screen without leaving sign-in.

actions.label: Privacy Policy
actions.meaning: Opens the inline Privacy Policy document on the Login screen without leaving sign-in.

actions.label: Close legal document
actions.meaning: Closes the inline legal document and returns to the Login screen.

actions.label: Back to welcome
actions.meaning: Returns from Login to One's public welcome screen through the canonical onboarding hierarchy, preserving only a valid pending destination.

actions.label: Open Marketplace RIA Profile
actions.meaning: Navigates to a public marketplace RIA profile route.

navigation_prerequisites: RIA profile identifier should be known for a full profile view.

actions.label: Request Advisory Access
actions.meaning: Creates an investor-to-RIA advisory consent request for the current marketplace profile.

navigation_prerequisites: Signed-in investor persona must be active.
RIA profile must be loaded.
RIA profile must have a connectable verification status.

execution_hint.reason: Creating an investor-to-RIA consent request must stay user-triggered on the marketplace profile.

actions.label: Manage RIA Profile
actions.meaning: Navigates an active RIA persona from their public marketplace profile back to profile management.

navigation_prerequisites: Active persona must be RIA.

actions.label: Continue Browsing Marketplace
actions.meaning: Returns from the marketplace RIA profile to the marketplace browsing surface.

actions.label: Open Public Disclosure
actions.meaning: Opens the external public disclosure URL attached to the marketplace RIA profile.

navigation_prerequisites: Profile must expose a public disclosures URL.

execution_hint.reason: External disclosure URLs are dynamic profile state and should be opened manually.

actions.label: Open Receipts Page
actions.meaning: Navigates directly to receipts page from any investor surface.

navigation_prerequisites: navigate to Gmail surface if route is currently outside Gmail scope

actions.label: Connect Gmail
actions.meaning: Starts OAuth flow for Gmail receipts connector.

execution_hint.reason: Only local component handler exists (handleConnectGmail in GmailReceiptsPage).

actions.label: Sync Gmail Receipts Now
actions.meaning: Queues and polls Gmail receipt sync run.

execution_hint.reason: Implemented only in local page handlers; no shared voice/action adapter yet.

actions.label: Disconnect Gmail
actions.meaning: Disconnects Gmail OAuth credentials for future syncs.

execution_hint.reason: Only local component handler exists (handleDisconnectGmail in GmailReceiptsPage).

actions.label: Open Analysis Surface
actions.meaning: Navigates directly to the Kai analysis workspace and history route.

actions.label: Open Analysis History
actions.meaning: Navigates to analysis page history context.

actions.label: Start Stock Analysis
actions.meaning: Opens the stock comparison preview so the user can confirm context before the debate starts.

required_inputs.name: pick_source
required_inputs.prompt: Which list should Kai use for this debate?

actions.label: Resume Active Analysis Run
actions.meaning: Attaches to currently running debate task and opens focused analysis route.

navigation_prerequisites: active debate run must exist for this user

actions.label: Cancel Active Analysis Run
actions.meaning: Cancels running debate task and returns to history view.

navigation_prerequisites: active debate run must exist for this user

actions.label: Legacy Transcript Tab Route
actions.meaning: Legacy tab token accepted by parser but no transcript tab is rendered in current analysis UI.

navigation_prerequisites: analysis route must be loaded

execution_hint.reason: No transcript tab trigger/content exists in app/kai/analysis/page.tsx.

actions.label: Open Email
actions.meaning: Navigates to One email request review.

navigation_prerequisites: user must be signed in

actions.label: Manage Verified Emails
actions.meaning: Opens the verified email address panel used to match email requests.

navigation_prerequisites: user must be signed in

execution_hint.reason: Requires opening the local verified email panel in /one/kyc.

actions.label: Sync Email Status
actions.meaning: Refreshes the selected email request status after consent approval.

navigation_prerequisites: user must be signed in

execution_hint.reason: Requires selected workflow context from /one/kyc.

actions.label: Review Email Draft
actions.meaning: Reads or focuses the current approval-gated email draft.

navigation_prerequisites: user must be signed in

execution_hint.reason: Requires selected workflow context and user-visible draft state.

actions.label: Request Email Redraft
actions.meaning: Requests a new email draft revision from typed or spoken user instructions.

navigation_prerequisites: user must be signed in

execution_hint.reason: Requires selected workflow context and captured redraft instructions.

actions.label: Approve Email Send
actions.meaning: Sends the email draft only after explicit user approval.

navigation_prerequisites: user must be signed in

execution_hint.reason: Voice must not send mail until the selected workflow and explicit confirmation are wired to the same UI approval endpoint.

actions.label: Reject Email Draft
actions.meaning: Rejects the current email draft and blocks the workflow.

navigation_prerequisites: user must be signed in

execution_hint.reason: Requires selected workflow context from /one/kyc.

actions.label: Open Information Marketplace
actions.meaning: Navigates to the One Information Marketplace (personal data-slice) route.

actions.label: Open Agents
actions.meaning: Navigates to the One Agents dashboard.

actions.label: Open Location
actions.meaning: Navigates to the One Location agent route.

actions.label: Open Memory
actions.meaning: Navigates to the One Memory route.

actions.label: Finish linking setup
actions.meaning: Records an active CRM record binding and returns to setup.

navigation_prerequisites: An active CRM record binding exists.

actions.label: Skip linking setup
actions.meaning: Returns to the setup hub without recording linked systems as complete.

actions.label: Finish KYC setup
actions.meaning: Records a verified email identity and initialized client connector, then returns to setup.

navigation_prerequisites: A verified email identity and client connector are ready.

actions.label: Skip KYC setup
actions.meaning: Returns to the setup hub without recording KYC as complete.

actions.label: Finish Finance setup
actions.meaning: Records a settled Plaid connection, statement save, or explicit later source choice and returns to setup.

navigation_prerequisites: Finance preferences and one source choice are settled.

actions.label: Skip Finance setup
actions.meaning: Returns to the setup hub without recording Finance as complete.

actions.label: Connect Gmail
actions.meaning: Presents the exact Connect Gmail action so a confirming tap can open the secure Gmail popup while the private-agent session remains active.

actions.label: Finish Gmail setup
actions.meaning: Records an already verified Gmail connection as complete and returns to the setup hub.

actions.label: Skip Gmail setup
actions.meaning: Leaves Gmail setup and returns to the setup hub without recording Gmail as complete.

actions.label: Answer Investment Horizon
actions.meaning: Answers the investment horizon question in the Kai preferences wizard.

required_inputs.name: investment_horizon
required_inputs.prompt: How long do you expect to keep this money invested: less than 3 years, 3 to 7 years, or more than 7 years?

actions.label: Answer Drawdown Response
actions.meaning: Answers the portfolio-drawdown-reaction question in the Kai preferences wizard.

navigation_prerequisites: Investment horizon must already be answered.

required_inputs.name: drawdown_response
required_inputs.prompt: If your portfolio drops 20 percent, would you reduce investments, stay invested, or buy more?

actions.label: Answer Volatility Preference
actions.meaning: Answers the volatility-comfort question in the Kai preferences wizard.

navigation_prerequisites: Drawdown response must already be answered.

required_inputs.name: volatility_preference
required_inputs.prompt: Which feels more comfortable: smaller steadier returns, moderate ups and downs, or larger swings for higher potential returns?

actions.label: Save Finance Preferences
actions.meaning: Saves Finance preferences, marks only Finance ready, and returns to the One setup hub without resolving root onboarding.

navigation_prerequisites: All three preference questions must be answered.

actions.label: Finish Location setup
actions.meaning: Records granted device location permission and returns to the setup hub.

navigation_prerequisites: Device location permission is granted.

actions.label: Skip Location setup
actions.meaning: Returns to the setup hub without recording Location as complete.

actions.label: Finish RIA setup
actions.meaning: Records a non-rejected RIA profile submission and returns to setup.

navigation_prerequisites: The RIA profile submission is not rejected.

actions.label: Skip RIA setup
actions.meaning: Returns to the setup hub without recording RIA as complete.

actions.label: Claim your One
actions.meaning: Continues from One's public welcome screen to sign in and begin setup.

actions.label: Open Profile
actions.meaning: Navigates to profile landing route.

actions.label: Open Gmail
actions.meaning: Navigates to the canonical Gmail receipts workspace.

navigation_prerequisites: Gmail route must be reachable

actions.label: Open Connected Systems Panel
actions.meaning: Navigates to the Connected Systems route.

navigation_prerequisites: Connected Systems route must be reachable

actions.label: Open Support Panel
actions.meaning: Navigates to hidden support panel in Profile > Account.

navigation_prerequisites: profile route must be active
query params tab=account & panel=support

actions.label: Open Vault Security Panel
actions.meaning: Navigates to hidden security panel in Profile > Privacy.

navigation_prerequisites: profile route must be active
query params tab=privacy & panel=security

actions.label: Open PKM
actions.meaning: Navigates to the canonical Saved Intelligence PKM workspace.

navigation_prerequisites: vault must be available for encrypted PKM details

actions.label: Submit Support Message
actions.meaning: Sends support/bug/developer feedback email via support service.

execution_hint.reason: submitSupportMessage is local to ProfilePage and not exported to global executor.

actions.label: Toggle Marketplace Visibility
actions.meaning: Opts investor persona in/out of RIA marketplace discoverability.

execution_hint.reason: Only handled by local Switch in ProfilePage.

actions.label: Sign Out
actions.meaning: Ends current session and redirects to home route.

execution_hint.reason: handleSignOut exists only in ProfilePage and is not bound to voice/global executor.

actions.label: Delete Account
actions.meaning: Deletes investor/ria persona or full account depending on selected target.

navigation_prerequisites: vault unlock may be required before delete confirmation

execution_hint.reason: Delete flow is intentionally local + guarded by dialogs and vault unlock.

actions.label: Generate PKM capture preview
actions.meaning: Builds the current PKM Agent Lab capture preview without saving it.

actions.label: Save PKM capture
actions.meaning: Persists the current PKM Agent Lab capture into encrypted PKM storage.

navigation_prerequisites: a saveable PKM capture preview must already exist

execution_hint.reason: Voice may prepare the preview only. PKM persistence requires the visible review card and an owner-confirmed PkmMutationPlanV2.

actions.label: Choose Country Code
actions.meaning: Selects one authored country-code option from the open phone country picker.

navigation_prerequisites: The country picker must be open.

required_inputs.name: country
required_inputs.prompt: Which visible country or country code should I choose?

actions.label: Close Country Picker
actions.meaning: Closes the open country-code picker and returns focus to the country field.

navigation_prerequisites: The country picker must be open.

actions.label: Submit Phone Number
actions.meaning: Sends a verification code to the phone number the user says.

required_inputs.name: phone_number
required_inputs.prompt: What's your phone number, including country code?

actions.label: Submit Verification Code
actions.meaning: Confirms the six-digit SMS code after an explicit inline confirmation and completes phone verification. The code is sensitive and must never be repeated or retained.

navigation_prerequisites: A verification code must already be sent.

required_inputs.name: verification_code
required_inputs.prompt: Say or type the six-digit code. Spoken codes are processed by the voice service.

actions.label: Open RIA Clients
actions.meaning: Navigates to the RIA client roster route.

navigation_prerequisites: RIA onboarding must be complete.

actions.label: Open Client Workspace
actions.meaning: Represents visible client row buttons. Choosing a specific dynamic client remains manual until voice carries a selected client id.

navigation_prerequisites: A connected client row must be selected.

execution_hint.reason: Client workspace routes require a dynamic investor user id from the clicked row.

actions.label: Open RIA Connect Marketplace
actions.meaning: Navigates from the RIA shell to the marketplace connection surface.

actions.label: Open RIA Onboarding
actions.meaning: Navigates to the professional onboarding route for advisor verification.

navigation_prerequisites: RIA workspace must be available or in setup for this account.

actions.label: Verify Advisor Name
actions.meaning: Represents the advisor-name verification button. The actual verification call stays manual because it uses the current form value.

navigation_prerequisites: Advisor display name must be entered.
No verification request may already be running.

execution_hint.reason: Advisor name verification depends on current form state and must be triggered from the visible onboarding control.

actions.label: Submit RIA Verification
actions.meaning: Represents the final onboarding submission. Voice can explain it, but the user must submit from the review screen.
aliases: send my advisor profile for review

navigation_prerequisites: Current onboarding step must be review.
Required onboarding fields must pass the local flow guard.
Advisor name verification must be satisfied for live submission.

execution_hint.reason: RIA verification submission changes persona/profile state and must remain user-triggered on the review screen.

actions.label: Bypass RIA Verification In Dev
actions.meaning: Represents the development or UAT-only RIA activation bypass. It is always manual-only for voice.

navigation_prerequisites: Development RIA bypass must be allowlisted.
Advisor display name must be entered.

execution_hint.reason: Development-only RIA activation must be clicked intentionally in the onboarding UI.

actions.label: Open RIA Home
actions.meaning: Navigates to the RIA workspace home route.

navigation_prerequisites: RIA workspace must be available for this account.

actions.label: Open Priority Queue Item
actions.meaning: Represents the visible priority queue Open buttons on RIA home. Dynamic queue URLs still require the on-screen control.

navigation_prerequisites: A priority queue item with an href must be visible.

execution_hint.reason: Priority queue item URLs are dynamic screen state and are not safe to execute from the static gateway yet.

actions.label: Open RIA Picks
actions.meaning: Navigates to the RIA stock universe and advisor package route.

navigation_prerequisites: RIA onboarding must be complete.

actions.label: Show Kai Picks Source
actions.meaning: Switches the picks route state to Kai's read-only reference list.

actions.label: Show My Advisor Picks
actions.meaning: Switches the picks route state to the advisor's own package.

actions.label: Show Top Picks
actions.meaning: Switches the picks route state to top picks.

actions.label: Show Avoid List
actions.meaning: Switches the picks route state to avoid rows.

actions.label: Show Screening Rules
actions.meaning: Switches the picks route state to screening rules.

actions.label: Edit Advisor Package
actions.meaning: Represents opening the editable advisor package draft. Voice can explain it, but editing stays manual.

navigation_prerequisites: My list source must be selected.
Vault must be unlocked.

execution_hint.reason: The advisor package editor mutates local draft state and is not exposed as a voice tool.

actions.label: Save Advisor Package
actions.meaning: Represents saving the advisor package to vault-backed pick storage. Voice cannot complete the save.

navigation_prerequisites: Editor must be open.
Draft must have unsaved changes.
Vault must be unlocked.

execution_hint.reason: Saving advisor picks writes vault-backed PKM and API state and must stay user-triggered.

actions.label: Upload Top Picks CSV
actions.meaning: Represents the CSV upload and replace flow. File picking and upload remain manual.

navigation_prerequisites: My list source must be selected.
Upload panel must be open.
A CSV file must be selected.
Vault must be unlocked.

execution_hint.reason: CSV file selection and replacement are browser/file-system interactions and must stay manual.

actions.label: Copy Kai Package Into My List
actions.meaning: Represents copying Kai reference picks into the advisor draft. Voice can explain it, but the copy stays manual.
aliases: use kai list as my list

navigation_prerequisites: My list source must be selected.
Vault must be unlocked.
Kai package rows must be available.

execution_hint.reason: Copying the Kai package replaces local advisor draft state and must stay user-triggered.

workflow_steps.label: Copy Kai Package Into My List

actions.label: Discard Advisor Package Changes
actions.meaning: Represents discarding unsaved advisor package draft changes. Voice cannot discard for the user.

navigation_prerequisites: Editor must be open.

execution_hint.reason: Discarding draft changes must stay user-triggered.

actions.label: Edit Picks Rows Manually
actions.meaning: Covers row-level add, remove, ticker, tier, thesis, avoid reason, and screening rule edits that require hands-on UI entry.

navigation_prerequisites: My list source must be selected.
Editor must be open.
Vault must be unlocked.

execution_hint.reason: Row-level editing requires structured manual input inside the picks editor.

actions.label: Download Picks CSV Template
actions.meaning: Navigates to the CSV template used for top-picks uploads.

actions.label: Open RIA Profile
actions.meaning: Opens the advisor's own RIA profile built during onboarding, with view and edit of services, fees, bio, and business location.

navigation_prerequisites: RIA persona must be provisioned (onboarding complete) before the profile is available.

actions.label: Edit RIA services and fees
actions.meaning: Opens the profile edit panel to update services, fee structure, minimum engagement, bio, and business location.

actions.label: Open RIA Requests
actions.meaning: Routes legacy RIA requests links to the consent center.

navigation_prerequisites: Consent center must be available.

actions.label: Open RIA Settings
actions.meaning: Routes RIA profile management links to the profile settings surface.

navigation_prerequisites: RIA persona must be available before profile settings routing.

actions.meaning: Routes legacy RIA workspace links to a client workspace when a clientId is present, otherwise to the client roster.

navigation_prerequisites: Optional clientId determines whether the route resolves to a client workspace or the client roster.

actions.label: Ask Location

find people i can connect with

navigation_prerequisites: trusted-connection writes require governed confirmation

how much did i spend at

actions.label: Ask Connected Systems

required_inputs.prompt: What should I ask Connected Systems?

how many listings have i put available on marketplace
what have i published to the information marketplace
how much is my data worth

navigation_prerequisites: marketplace information requires vault and marketplace readiness

required_inputs.name: utterance
required_inputs.prompt: What should I ask the Information Marketplace?

actions.meaning: Delegates pending Information Marketplace request review to the specialist and requires chat confirmation before any approval or denial mutation.
aliases: can you approve any pending request for information marketplace

navigation_prerequisites: marketplace approvals require explicit owner confirmation

required_inputs.name: utterance
required_inputs.prompt: What should I ask the Information Marketplace request reviewer?

actions.meaning: Navigates to the advisor-facing detail route for a selected client account branch.

Account branch must be visible to the RIA workspace.

actions.label: Return To Client Information Explorer
actions.meaning: Navigates from an unavailable account detail route back to the client workspace explorer tab.

navigation_prerequisites: Client identifier must be known.

actions.label: Open RIA Client Request Detail
actions.meaning: Navigates to the advisor-facing detail route for a selected client access request.

navigation_prerequisites: Client identifier and request identifier must be known.
Request must be present in the client workspace history.

execution_hint.reason: Opening a specific request detail requires a dynamic request id selected from workspace history.

actions.label: Return To Client Access
actions.meaning: Navigates from an unavailable request detail route back to the client workspace access tab.

navigation_prerequisites: Client identifier must be known.

actions.label: Open RIA Client Workspace
actions.meaning: Navigates to a selected client's advisor workspace.

navigation_prerequisites: Client identifier must be known.

actions.label: Show Client Overview
actions.meaning: Switches the client workspace to the overview tab.

navigation_prerequisites: Client identifier must be known.

actions.label: Show Client Sharing
actions.meaning: Switches the client workspace to the access and sharing tab.

navigation_prerequisites: Client identifier must be known.

actions.meaning: Switches the client workspace to the portfolio tab when approved client portfolio access is ready.

actions.label: Show Client Information Explorer

actions.meaning: Opens a selected account branch detail route from the client workspace.

actions.label: Open Access Manager
actions.meaning: Navigates to the consent access manager from the client workspace.

navigation_prerequisites: Client identifier must be known.

actions.label: Send Client Access Request
actions.meaning: Creates a consent request bundle for the selected client using the selected template, scopes, accounts, and optional reason.

navigation_prerequisites: Access tab must be open.
A request template must be available.
At least one scope must be selected.
Required account selections must be present.
Test profiles cannot send real requests.

execution_hint.reason: Sending an access request uses selected scopes, account ids, and client-visible note state and must remain user-triggered.

actions.label: Disconnect Client Relationship
actions.meaning: Disconnects the current advisor-client relationship and ends access immediately.

navigation_prerequisites: Client detail must be loaded.
Relationship must not be a self relationship.
Test profiles cannot disconnect real relationships.

execution_hint.reason: Disconnecting a client relationship is destructive and must remain user-triggered.
